title: Trucker's UFO sighting and missing time, from Texas to Nevada government land
place_text: Left I-20 near El Paso, Texas; ended up on government property in Nevada, USA

tellings.quote: I thought I was in Texas, you know. No, you're in Nevada. [laughter]

plain: In 1977 a truck driver saw a UFO on Interstate 20 near El Paso, Texas, then lost a stretch of time he cannot account for, and came to on government land in Nevada. Michael Johnson, an Air Force veteran who says it happened to him, tells Michels he was told so to his face: "I thought I was in Texas, you know. No, you're in Nevada."
